title: Release-prep fails when CHANGELOG Unreleased carries a breaking-change marker and the chosen bump is patch-level (mirror of quest-cli QCLI-328)
description: Filed on opum-agent's dispatch (OPAG-665 AC2, 2026-09-28). ADR read by ref: opum-doc docs/adr/gate-release-prep-on-a-breaking-changelog-entry-at-a-patch-bump.md at 724fc0959f0b (blob 9fc3ecde). quest-cli's QCLI-328 gates its release-prep on its own CHANGELOG; lore-cli mirrors it over lore's CHANGELOG.md. Because lore and quest share one version (constitution Article 3 clause 1), a breaking entry in EITHER changelog forces the pair's bump. Read QCLI-328's implementation by ref before building, and match its marker vocabulary and verdicts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lore release-prep fails (non-zero, message naming the entry and the bump) when CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] carries a breaking-change marker and the chosen bump is patch-level, and passes on the same tree at a minor/major bump -- proven both ways on ONE tree
The breaking-change marker vocabulary and verdicts match quest-cli QCLI-328, read by ref and cited with its SHA; any difference is named and agreed with quest-cli
How a break in quest-cli's changelog forces lore's bump (the shared version) is stated and either enforced or explicitly left to the pairing, per the ADR
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0; a reviewer pass covers any scripts/ or release.yml change

implementationNotes: ORCHESTRATOR RULING on AC3 (opum-agent, cross-session, 2026-09-28): ENFORCED, not left to the pairing. Per the ADR's Consequences (opum-doc docs/adr/gate-release-prep-on-a-breaking-changelog-entry-at-a-patch-bump.md, main), the check runs against BOTH changelogs before either side releases. Lore's release-prep also reads quest-cli's CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] BY REF (GitHub API on quest-cli's dev, or the paired release ref) and applies the same marker-vs-patch rule, and it FAILS if it cannot read it (an unreadable changelog is not a clean one). quest-cli files the mirror follow-up. Its per-repo gate, whose vocabulary AC2 matches, is opum-ai/quest-cli#367 (QCLI-328). Re-read the ADR by ref when starting, since this is a relay; the ADR is the binding record.
